summary: Timeboxed request: minimal prod event segment for EU data correction
description:
Issue summary: A product manager in EU region submitted a Data Subject Request to correct a small set of customer-provided prompts that were misattributed to the wrong account. Legal approved a tightly scoped, time-limited extraction of only the event IDs and minimal associated metadata for correction. We need engineering to produce a minimized event segment (no raw user payloads, no full traces) and an access plan that satisfies privacy requirements.

Impact: The customer experiences incorrect attribution on 3 transactions affecting billing and audit trails. Business impact is localized to one enterprise account; regulatory risk is moderate if not addressed within 7 days.

Requested deliverable: A timeboxed (48h access window) package containing only: event IDs, timestamps, hashed session ids, model_id, route_id, and a one-line normalized reason field. No raw prompt/response text, no embeddings, no KV cache contents. Package must be exported to a secure S3 bucket with KMS encryption and strict ACLs.

Authorizations: Legal (Sara Mendes) provided written approval on 2026-03-09; Privacy flagged minimal fields; InfoSec pre-approved export method pending SRE confirmation.

Acceptance criteria: 1) Export contains only approved fields and matches sample schema provided by Legal. 2) Access window enforced via temporary IAM role that auto-revokes. 3) Audit log entries recorded and ticket updated with links.

Notes: This is NOT a general log access request; do not broaden scope. Follow redaction checklist in Confluence and include redaction steps in the README shipped with the export.
impact: Localized account data correction for EU customer; regulatory timeline 7 days; medium risk if delayed.
steps_to_reproduce: 1) Receive Legal authorization and sample schema from Sara Mendes (done).
2) Identify candidate event IDs via keyed query on minimal predicate (account_id + time window).
3) Run minimized projection to extract only approved fields to temp table in analytics cluster.
4) Sanity-check against sample schema and redaction checklist.
5) Export to KMS-encrypted S3 path with temporary IAM role and notify Legal and requester.
logs: See analytics query run log: /var/log/analytics/job-20260311-evextract.log and SRE runbook link in Confluence.
